note: Hand-placed word hunt targets, read off the source artwork. See _why.
_why: The drafts carry wordHunts for every pack, but 286 of their 315 hitboxes are byte-identical
to a difference coordinate — the prompt text was written by a person and the coordinates were
copied from the difference list. Those difference coordinates do not sit on the artwork either,
so wiring the draft data would reproduce the exact bug it looks like it fixes: the prompt names
an object, you tap that object, and the game says you missed.
Unlike differences, this cannot be measured. 'Where do the two pictures differ' is arithmetic;
'where is the prism' is not. So these are placed by eye against the source image, which is how
the three original preview packs were built. Only packs listed here get word hunts.
Coordinates are normalised to the source image (0..1), origin top-left. Radius must stay at or
above 0.06 so the tap target clears 44pt on a ~390pt board, and two targets in the same pack
must be further apart than the sum of their radii.
